Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A place phrase normally comes before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，Use 假装 before an action to mean pretending to do it; 装 does not directly fit before 祭拜 in this meaning. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和他的朋友，Since 孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character intervenes, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: reference_form]
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at age five, so use 了 to mark the completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”之前。
“装祭拜”搭配不成立，“假装祭拜”是正确的说法。
孟子刚在前一句出现，按近距离重复指代规则应改用“他”。
五岁时搬家是一次完成的事件，应说“搬了家”。
